title: MCHD-FAX01: 12 Unexplained KDHE Faxes

fields.subject: MCHD-FAX01 shows 12 new inbound faxes from KDHE. No one in Epi sent a batch to state. Logs show no new email to the Epi inbox.
fields.description: MCHD-FAX01 shows 12 new inbound faxes from KDHE. No one in Epi sent a batch to state. Logs show no new email to the Epi inbox. All faxes were received between 08:45 and 08:55. No corresponding email or manual entry in the Epi inbox. No user action recorded on MCHD-F-10. The system shows no error, but the timing gap suggests a potential data injection. Verify integrity of the inbound stream and review MCHD-FAX01 logs for anomalies.

activity.text: Ticket created from automated monitoring of MCHD-FAX01.

activity.author: County IT Helpdesk
activity.text: Confirmed: 12 faxes from KDHE received at 08:45–08:55. No Epi user initiated batch. No email in Epi inbox. No manual entry on MCHD-F-10. Requesting immediate forensic review.

instructorNote: This inject introduces a data integrity anomaly. IT must detect the gap in fax timestamps and recognize it as a potential attack vector. Watch for whether IT checks the fax log against known Epi workflows and flags the anomaly.
